decisive_items: Flat-topped pink to erythematous papules over knuckles
Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
response.rationale: R1 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the raw vignette spans, including specific skin findings and muscle weakness, although the muscle biopsy did not show inflammatory myositis. R3 is the runner-up because it has a strong temporal association between ipilimumab treatment and the development of skin symptoms, but it lacks specific support for dermatomyositis.

rejected.why: Lack of specific skin findings and muscle weakness support
Muscle biopsy did not show inflammatory myositis, contradicting polymyositis diagnosis
Lack of specific support for dermatitis beyond temporal association with ipilimumab treatment
Append-only completion candidate with no additional supporting evidence beyond parent candidate R1
